Its defensive capabilities are respectable, but its predictably slipshod craftsmanship spells low durability.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Dragonbone Boko Shield'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} Dragonbone Boko Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 25 |durability = 8 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Boko Shield}} Dragonbone Boko Shields are [[Boko Shield]]s that have been upgraded and reinforced with fossilized bone. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and maintained by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Though they provide a respectable defense, the poor craftsmanship used to make them leaves them with low [[Durability]]. They are used by [[Black Bokoblin]], [[Silver Bokoblin]], and [[Golden Bokoblin]]. High-tier [[Moblin]]s also make use of these [[Shield]]s. As they are made of wood, Dragonbone Boko Shields will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and unlike metal [[Shield]]s, they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, they cannot be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. If scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune, the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Dragonbone Boko Shield. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_006" |Life = 8 |GuardPower = 25 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 23 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 25 |durability = 8 |flammable = yes |magnetic = no |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Dragonbone Boko Shield}} {{Stub}} Dragonbone Boko Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Dragonbone Boko Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Dragonbone Boko Club]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Boko Shield * Bokoblin Gear * Shield * Spiked Boko Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
